youtube_description:
The” Pune Shikshak Gaurav Puruskar , 2019” is one of such prestigious awards by PAI College of VEDA under which eminent Educationist / Principals/ Teachers from all India who have excelled and made extraordinary contribution in their respective field of Education are honoured by the Institution. The awards intend to give recognition for their outstanding achievements in the field by presenting them “Pune Shikshak Gaurav Puruskar”
The Sardar Dastur Nosherwan Girls' High School was founded on 1st February 1893. It is a Charitable Minority Institution under a Charitable Minority Trust. It is a recognized Secondary School and admits girls without distinction of caste and creed.
The school motto ‘Humata, Hukata, Huvarashta’- ‘Good Thoughts, Good Words, Good Deeds’ is the guiding light that focuses on the very essence of human existence. – Mrs. Sandhya Yannuwar ,the Principal of Sardar Dastur Nosherwan Girls' High School
